open_points.subject: M29 OwnerFormField — Source of truth
open_points.text:
The release: the data provider's owner form table. The generated code reads
the table, so a constant of the data provider delivers it (SPEC_STANDARD
§15.3.1), as it delivers the seven tables of M22–M28; a `models` catalog of
the same table would not reach the code, and none is declared.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The passage must name the exact imported data-provider constant that delivers the owner form table, rather than leaving its symbol for generation to guess.
